item.title: You May Never See Another Couple Full of Christ-Like Love Like This
item.description: When Larissa met Ian at college in 2005, she never dreamed she'd one day be his wife ... and his caretaker. After a tragic accident left Ian without the ability to speak, walk or care for himself, she did what any woman in love would do: she married him.

item.title: This 100-Year-Old Lady Is the Only Person Who Can Say This and Get Away with It
item.description: Dorothy Custer is the definition of gumption. Listen to her tell the story of how she met her husband, then at 2:10 she reveals the secret to long life (btw, it's the cutest thing ever).

item.title: He’d Take a Bullet for Her and at 1:50 You Won’t Doubt Him a Bit
item.description: This sister and brother duo have the most beautiful relationship in the world. When he says his life would be nothing without his little sister, you'll be moved to tears.

item.title: Think Sex Out of Marriage Is No Big Deal? Well, This Could Change Your Mind Forever
item.description: When you hear the real--biblical--reason behind sex, it's more beautiful and rich than you could ever imagine.

item.title: She Was Married for Six Weeks When She Lost Her Husband to the War. Now She Knows the Truth.
item.description: Watch this war widow discover the truth about her missing husband after searching for 68 years. You won't believe why it took so long, but you'll be amazed by the answers she finds.

item.title: When She Says, “Keep Your Breasts to Yourself,” I Think She Means It
item.description: Popular Bible teacher Beth Moore discusses mean girls, flirts, and how to exude modestly in a sex-obsessed world.

item.title: Bikini Facts That Will Probably Blow Your Mind—What You Need to Know Before Hitting the Pool
item.description: This girl is a serious rockstar. In a mere 9 minutes, she totally demolishes everything you've ever thought about bikinis. Maybe modest is hottest, after all?

item.title: People Were Stunned When She Chose to Marry Him. They Said it Could Never Work. 3 Years Later, Things Couldn’t Be Better.
item.description: Despite his life-altering accident, she chose to marry him. That was three years ago. Watch what’s happening now. Jump to 7:35 for the update :)

item.title: 50 Shades or Song of Solomon? How Well Do You Know Your Bible?
item.description: There's been a lot of buzz about the new "50 Shades" movie, but can you tell the difference between pop culture and the Bible? Find out in this 50 Shades/Song of Solomon quiz.

item.title: Denzel Washington Just Took These Grads to Church!
item.description: Denzel Washington just gave an incredible commencement speech at New Orleans' Dillard University. His main advice for the graduates? "Put God first in everything you do."
